name: drover
description: Drupal/Acquia application-error log analysis pipeline. Pulls 30 days of historical error logs by date from the Acquia Cloud Platform API, parses + fingerprints + groups errors, diagnoses causes from a pattern library, and renders monthly reports — markdown or self-contained Velir-branded HTML — with bar charts, stakeholder narratives, and JIRA ticket recommendations. Three execution paths for ticket creation: Atlassian MCP, direct REST, or plan-only.
